ui.hero.title: Every animal you keep, on a single platform
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your sites. You can check every operation in Antz on real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap a card and a guide including all features and screens opens.
ui.cta.text: This guide carries the features and real screens of each module. You can proceed from where you left off last time, or please feel free to contact us. We will support you.
ui.day.title: The flow of the first day of starting to use Antz
ui.day.2: Grasp the structure of the screens
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles matched to your organization and enable permissions for each module. This lets each person see only the information needed for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Can it be used on both smartphones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app supports on-site work such as notes, treatment, movement and egg records. The web app supports office work such as the hospital system, brooder room setup, reports and pharmacy inventory. Updates are reflected in real time on smartphones, tablets and computers.
ui.faq.q3: Can we manage who can view what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is managed based on roles. Create the roles your organization uses (e.g. zoologist) and enable permissions for each module.
ui.faq.q4: We operate multiple sites; is this supported?
ui.faq.a4: Antz manages the data of all sites and departments together in one place. Animal housing facilities are organized in units of site, section and animal house, and movement between sites requires approval and a security checkout.
ui.faq.a5: First read the "Getting Started" guide, then open the modules used by your own role. If there is anything unclear, please contact hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The autopsy module records post-mortem examinations, together with detailed findings, organ-by-organ findings and medical conclusions. It supports accurate cause-of-death analysis, standardizes reporting, ensures timely handling of dead bodies, and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filter
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species, and narrow down by site, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Check each stage: received, unprocessed, draft and completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause of death, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The deworming module systematically records and monitors parasite-control treatments, and makes it possible to carry out every deworming for each animal in a timely way, record it properly and track it clearly.
m.deworming.f1.title: Display by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Classifies dewormings into upcoming, not yet done, skipped and completed, so they can be checked easily.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Specify the date and details to schedule a deworming course, or directly record medicine that has been administered.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Record dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Animal housing facilities
m.housing.intro: The housing module organizes animal habitats by site, section and animal house, grasps where every animal is, and records every change. Access to each tier is managed based on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Site management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add and edit sites safely and systematically with role-based permissions.
m.housing.f2.title: Section management
m.housing.f2.desc: Safely add and edit sections within the park under permission-based control.
m.housing.f3.title: Animal house management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add and edit animal houses, monitor each one, and manage animals and data efficiently.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The fetal death module records and manages cases of fetal death that occurred in animal houses, recording the cause, timing and details of the related animals. It supports veterinary care, breeding health monitoring, trend analysis and improvement of population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding fetal death records
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases, causes, timing, parent-child relationships and animal information. [?]
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filter
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword, and narrow down by site, date, stillbirth or miscarriage, species and sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: You can check everything: details, days since death, cause, ID, animal house, site and sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the entire life cycle of an egg, from laying to hatching or movement to the brooder room. It ensures accurate records, real-time updates and complete traceability, and increases coordination and accountability among the nest, brooder room and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Real-time counts of eggs in the nest, eggs moved to the brooder room, and eggs scheduled for disposal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg registration (nest/brooder room)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs together with parents, condition, date, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the whole of the egg's progress timeline (Egg Journey Timeline).
m.administer-medicine.title: Medication dosing
m.administer-medicine.intro: The administration module complements medical records, converts prescriptions into executable treatment workflows, and makes it possible to provide care in real time to animals individually or in batch units, both on site and in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record on the selected date without creating a complete medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filter
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly, and narrow down the list by date, target, species and controlled substances.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: Check treatments by date in 4 tabs: not administered, administered, skipped and discontinued.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the entire life cycle of animal vaccination, from creating schedules and direct administration to tracking upcoming, not yet done, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely procedures and recording of accurate doses and complete traceability, and supports disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Display by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Classifies vaccinations into upcoming, not yet done, skipped and completed, so they can be checked easily.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Specify the date and medicine details to schedule a vaccination, or directly record a vaccine that has been administered.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Record dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Directly pay out medical supplies to authorized veterinarians in a quick, accurate and traceable form, achieving timely supply and automatic inventory updates from prescription to shelf. Batch-level visibility and expiry date tracking are possible throughout the whole process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: You can grasp in real time inventory problems, shipments, purchases, billing, usage, expiry and fast-moving products, and check trends in graphs to respond quickly. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filter
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request ID, doctor name and pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage places by the number of racks/shelves, and access and update quickly. You can customize data such as packaging, units (UOM), ingredients, drivers and manufacturers.
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Inventory report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Inventory by batch including amount and expiry date. Flag items that are short in stock or expired, monitor items whose expiry is near, and manage escrow and dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track inventory and expiry dates, record purchases/shipments, maintain an integrated ledger, and handle substitutes and variations.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Payout management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Veterinarians can prescribe and pay out, or receive medicine directly from the pharmacy, and everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track shipments of medicine arriving and leaving, and process them within the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Inventory adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record inventory fluctuations (loss, damage, expiry), retain audit history, manage returns to suppliers, and download consumption, return, purchase and payout reports for finance and demand forecasting.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The "Getting started" guide introduces the purpose of the app, and explains the basic steps for new users to set up a profile, check the main features and operate the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspace
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in safely and access the work environment assigned to you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and screen layout
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Check the latest information in the home feed, and use quick navigation shortcuts and the bottom panel that gathers the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Unprocessed autopsy / administration / assignment
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting autopsy, preparation of clerical documents, and subsequent assignment or disposal procedures, in the state before the final closing of the record.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master settings and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up master data and check modules such as medical records, animal housing facilities, eggs, feeding and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personal settings
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and change language settings.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for safe operation.
